feedTitle: Isle of Man 5 day weather forecast

items.title: 5 day forecast updated as of 25 October 2026 4:39am
items.description:
##Today##

Early showers becoming isolated, with bright spells & sunny intervals. Gale to severe gale force winds at first, slowly moderating.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 8°C and max. air temperature 12°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

0-2


##Wind Speed##

35


##Wind Direction##

W


##Wind##

West 40-50 gusts 60-65 at first, very gradually decreasing 25-30 gusts 40-45 by the evening, then backing SW 15 overnight.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate at first.


##Comments##

Severe gales at first, some further damage & travel disruption but the winds slowly decrease through the period. Significant coastal overtopping in west at high tide (approx. 10:25).


##Tomorrow##

Rain soon arriving, clearing in the afternoon, rain in the evening, clearing overnight. Becoming windy later in the day & at night.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 9°C and max. air temperature 15°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

5-10, risk of 15 on hills


##Wind Speed##

30


##Wind Direction##

SW


##Wind##

SW 15, soon backing SE 20-25, locally 25-30, veering S or S-SW 30-40 gusts 45-55 later in day, veering SW overnight.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate in rain. Hill fog developing.


##Comments##

Gales developing later in day. Coastal overtopping at high tide (approx. 11:00 & 23:25).


##Tuesday, 27 October 2026##

##Visibility##

##Comments##
